title: Home-Cooked
subtitle: 「家煮的／自家製的」，要先分清是在談『真的在家烹煮』、『由基本食材自己製作』，還是只是『家常菜風格』。
description: 「家煮的／自家製的」，要先分清是在談『真的在家烹煮』、『由基本食材自己製作』，還是只是『家常菜風格』。

words.example: They served homemade soup and fresh bread.
words.exampleZh: 他們供應自家製湯和新鮮麵包。

exercises.original: They served home-cooked soup and fresh bread.
exercises.zh: 他們供應自家製湯和新鮮麵包。
exercises.upgrade: They served homemade soup and fresh bread.

options.explanation: soup made at home can naturally be described as homemade。
fresh only describes how recently it was made。
healthy concerns nutrition, not preparation setting。
organic concerns ingredient-production standards。
traditional concerns style/history。
restaurant-made identifies the opposite preparation setting.

exercises.original: She brought a home-cooked cake to the party.

exercises.upgrade: She brought a homemade cake to the party.

options.explanation: a cake made personally at home is homemade。
fresh does not specify location。
healthy is not guaranteed。
organic concerns ingredients。
ready-made normally means bought prepared。
restaurant-made contradicts home production.

exercises.original: The café sells jars of home-cooked tomato sauce made by the owner.

options.explanation: made personally by the owner fits homemade even when later sold commercially。
fresh only concerns timing。
organic necessarily is not stated。
healthy is not the defining feature。
traditional may describe recipe style but not where it was made。
ready-made describes the state for the buyer, not the original handmade production.

exercises.zh: 廚房希望提供更多以基本食材製作、少用預製醬汁的餐點。
exercises.upgrade: The kitchen aims to serve more meals prepared from basic ingredients without relying on prepared sauces.

options.explanation: without prepared sauces + basic ingredients defines the preparation method。
homemade necessarily is wrong in an institutional kitchen。
organic/fresh/healthy/traditional are different attributes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 新鮮不等於 home-cooked fresh 表示新鮮；餐廳食物可以很新鮮但不是家煮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Freshness and place of preparation are different.

falseSynonyms.zh: 健康不等於 home-cooked 家煮食物可以健康，也可以高糖高脂；home-cooked 不保證營養質素。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Home-cooked does not automatically mean healthy.

falseSynonyms.zh: 有機不等於 home-cooked organic 是食材／生產標準；與在哪裏烹調無關。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Organic describes production standards, not cooking location.

falseSynonyms.zh: 傳統不等於 home-cooked traditional 指文化或歷史做法；家煮菜可以很現代。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Traditional and home-cooked overlap only sometimes.

falseSynonyms.zh: home-style 不等於一定 home-cooked 餐廳也可提供 home-style food；它描述風格，不是實際地點。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Home-style describes style, not where it was cooked.

falseSynonyms.zh: 即食／預製通常與 home-cooked 對比 ready-made 指預先製作、可直接食用或簡單加熱。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ready-made food is usually contrasted with home-cooked food.

falseSynonyms.zh: 餐廳製作不等於 home-cooked restaurant-made 指由餐廳製作，和家庭廚房來源不同。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Restaurant-made and home-cooked identify different preparation settings.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 home cooking 是名詞片語；home-cooked 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Home cooking is a noun phrase; home-cooked is an adjective.
